name: Yamamoto Mako
source: Student council vice president and protagonist's fiancé. Because she is daughter of old-fashioned family, she got strict personality and always pushes forward with her own belief despite lacking of experiences. She prohibits the protagonist from normal behaviors as couple like holding hands and kissing until marriage.
